en: A multi-view color postcard with a bright blue border, showing modern seaside resort buildings and beaches along a forested coastline. The top-right image shows a tall hotel tower labeled "International" on a busy beach by the sea. The lower-right and left images show terraced hotel complexes nestled in green hills and a marina or sailing club with small sailboats on the water. Large white Cyrillic text in the center reads "ЗЛАТНИ ПЯСЪЦИ".
